id./param/scenario/cs/b_010_cs_090.pack|cs_: "Whoa! This one's a biggun! The legendary man-eating mackerel!? I'm Blue John, and I won't lose! Hrraah!
"...Yes! I caught something! What a catch!!
"Even if the world's ended, there's still good in staying alive!
"Wh-Whaaat!? A p-person!? Hey, lad! Where'd you come from!?
"No matter how hungry you are, you don't pinch bait off another man's line! What on earth happened to you!?
"I don't know what's going on, but... there's some deep reason, ain't there?
"Right! Blue John never leaves anyone in trouble! That's a fisherman's way!
"Come to my hut and rest the night, lad. These days there ain't a safe place anywhere.
"But the Last Bastion might help you. There's a Hero there, our hope!
"Right, that's settled. Let's set sail. Hold on tight, lad. Things are about to get choppy..."
